Physician Onboarding / Offboarding

DR. SMITH IS A NEW PHYSICIAN EAGER TO PROVIDE EXCEPTIONAL CARE AND VALUES A STREAMLINED ONBOARDING PROCESS SO SHE CAN FOCUS ON HER PATIENTS.

Meet Dr. Smith,
Physician Onboarding / Offboarding

Dr. Smith is a newly hired physician navigating the challenges of credentialing, scheduling, and gaining access to critical systems needed to start providing care.

Life on The symplr Operations
Platform

The onboarding process typically has the potential for duplicative asks of a new physician and delays caused by multiple systems.

1. symplr Recruiting

A physician recruiter uses symplr Recruiting to hire Dr. Smith.

2. symplr Provider

Dr. Smith's information is automatically passed to symplr Provider, allowing the med staff team to start credentialing sooner and cutting down on duplicative tasks.

3. symplr Directory

Once credentialed, Dr. Smith's profile is automatically published in symplr Directory, ensuring accurate network listings

4. symplr Physician Scheduling

Dr. Smith's profile is also automatically created in symplr Physician Scheduling from the provider data in symplr Provider, decreasing the time and hand offs required to get Dr. Smith added to a schedule and starting to practice at this facility.

5. Physician Offboarding

Compliance gaps, outdated contracts, and adverse quality trends can put a hospital at risk. The symplr Operations Platform revolutionizes physician offboarding to address these challenges.

symplr Directory

Drive compliance with No Surprises Act by removing physician from digital directories and excluding them print-ready directories with symplr Directory.

symplr Contract

Ensure compliance and reduce financial risks by tracking contract expirations and time discrepancies with symplr Contract.

symplr Provider

Ensure only credentialed, qualified providers deliver care with centralized data and ongoing monitoring using symplr Provider.

Midas Statit

Identify and address systemic issues early with insights into metrics like readmissions, mortality, and infections using Midas Statit.

symplr Compliance

Mitigate risks by capturing compliance patterns, tracking policy acknowledgments, and documenting remediation efforts with symplr Compliance.

symplr Physician Scheduling

Streamline operations with symplr Physician Scheduling—remove physicians from shifts, reassign patients, and maintain a single source of truth to improve compliance and care.

Transform Physician Lifecycle Management

The symplr Operations Platform is the only solution to support the entire physician lifecycle, from onboarding to offboarding, to improve efficiency and productivity.
